name: Supravalvular Pulmonary Stenosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Imaging Diagnostic Criteria for Supravalvular Pulmonary Stenosis

criteria.description: Echocardiographic evidence of narrowing above the pulmonary valve with increased flow velocity
Hemodynamic confirmation of supravalvular obstruction via cardiac catheterization
Presence of a systolic ejection murmur best heard at the left upper sternal border
Identification of associated congenital heart defects such as peripheral pulmonary stenosis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Echocardiographic evidence of supravalvular pulmonary artery narrowing with confirmatory hemodynamic data from cardiac catheterization
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily based on imaging and hemodynamic studies; clinical findings support but are not definitive alone.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Systolic ejection murmur at left upper sternal border
searchTerms: heart murmur heard at upper left chest
systolic murmur at left upper sternum
ejection murmur at left upper chest
blockage in right heart outflow tract
obstruction of blood flow from right ventricle
enlarged right heart muscle on ECG
swelling and fatigue from right heart failure

imaging: Echocardiography showing supravalvular narrowing of the pulmonary artery
Cardiac catheterization demonstrating pressure gradient across supravalvular pulmonary stenosis
Cardiac MRI or CT angiography confirming anatomical location and severity
genetic: Possible association with elastin gene (ELN) mutations in syndromic cases
other: Chest X-ray may show post-stenotic dilation of pulmonary artery

distinguishingFeatures: Narrowing occurs at the pulmonary valve rather than above it
Valve leaflet abnormalities visible on echocardiography
Stenosis located in distal branches of pulmonary artery
May present with multiple segmental narrowings rather than a single supravalvular lesion

redFlags: Severe right ventricular hypertrophy with signs of heart failure
references: Maron BJ, et al. Clinical features and management of pulmonary artery stenosis. Circulation. 2020.
Orphanet: Supravalvular pulmonary stenosis. Orphanet Journal of Rare Diseases. 2019.
